svg.title: Compression has three different levers
svg.desc: QLoRA freezes a 4-bit NF4 base and trains LoRA adapters, reducing memory for fine-tuning. Pruning removes weights and only speeds inference when hardware supports the sparsity pattern. Distillation trains a smaller student to match a teacher’s soft outputs or sequences.

g.text: QLoRA freezes a 4-bit base, pruning removes weights, and distillation trains a smaller student.
QLoRA compresses the base for fine-tuning. Pruning keeps a sparse version of a model.
Distillation transfers the teacher’s output behavior to a separate student.
